test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statement(s) and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement(s).

Statements:

All meters are compasses.

All compasses are scales.

Conclusions:

(I) Some scales are compasses.

(II) All meters are scales.
solution:
Given Statements:

All meters are compasses.

All compasses are scales.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fc75571bf1700a5d8d57879fe32f9cbd918cb94f1aa34021b5aa94880026cea0.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some scales are compasses.

- Since "All compasses are scales" (Statement 2), it means the entire group of Compasses is part of the Scales group. Therefore, it is definitively true that at least "Some scales are compasses."

Conclusion (I) logically follows.

II. All meters are scales.
- Since "All meters are compasses" (Statement 1) and "All compasses are scales" (Statement 2), by the transitive property of inclusion, all meters must necessarily be scales.
Conclusion (II) logically follows.

So, Both Conclusion (I) and Conclusion (II) logically follow from the given statements.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
